productPageReviews.reviewTitle: I would strongly recommend to not buy this laptop
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I got this laptop on sale about 4 months ago. It's been a bumpy ride to say the least. This thing has been disappointing of both the hardware and the software front and as of right now I strongly regret buying it.Starting with the hardware, ASUS seemed to have cut as many corners as possible to bring the price of this machine down. On some level that's expected. Afterall, you're getting a 3060 gaming laptop for close to a grand, so thinking this is going to be a premium laptop is unrealistic. However, this system doesn't even meet the standards that most would expect from a budget laptop.For starters, one of the cooling fans is already failing and causing a grinding buzzing noise, with less than 4 months of use. I'm a fairly tech savvy person and I've replace fans in laptops before. Usually replacement parts are cheap and easy to find, but for this particular model, fans are almost non-existent, even on eBay. As a cherry on top, to remove the particular fan that's broken, you must remove the entire cooling system. That's right. Replacing the fan also means you're going to have to replace all the thermal paste on the CPU and GPU. Now of course you could ship this off to ASUS and enjoy a long period of not having you're computer available, but something as simple as a broken fan shouldn't be this much of a headache to fix yourself.And then there's the paper-thin flimsy frame. It's so weak that I can click the track pad by pressing on the bottom of the case. I've used this laptop while laying down and accidently clicked the track pad just by holding it from the bottom, with almost no pressure exerted. It's remarkable cheaply made. I imagine even a fall from a modest height would send this thing laptop heaven.The last hardware pain point is the screen. While the image quality is about what you'd expect from a laptop at this price point, the backlight bleed is absolutely terrible. Most of the time it's not noticeable but if you're watching something that has a dimly lit scene it can be very distracting. I've owned several laptops in this category and the screen on this is by far the worst in terms of bleed.And now we come to the software. Oh boy... Like many manufactures, ASUS uses there own proprietary software to mange system performance. ASUS' is called Armoury Crate. It is easily one of the most buggy and inconsistent pieces of software I've ever used. Sometimes it doesn't change modes properly. Sometimes it says it needs updates, but refuses to install them. Other times it decides to fire up all fans at idle, even in silent mode with no applications open. It's simply a mess. Now you might be wondering, "Well can't I just uninstall it and use other system management tools?" and while you probably could, you would miss out on one of the key selling points of this laptop: it's built-in MUX switch. This switch, as far as I can tell, is only controllable through Armoury Crate, so if you want to use it you're stuck with their broken software.Overall, I would steer clear from this one. I know, I know, it's tempting for the price... But it's simply not worth the trouble of dealing with both hardware and software problems. If it was just one of these things, maybe it'd be worth it. But there are many other options available that offer a far more reliable experience than this laptop.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Compré esta laptop porque tenía buenas prestaciones como memoria RAM, procesador, pantalla, teclado, etcétera, sin embargo, bajo mi punto de vista, recomiendo aumentar la ram mínimo al doble.Yo la compré con 16 gb de ram y la suelo utilizar para edición de fotografía, video y algunos programas de ingeniería como Autocad solidworks o revit.En los programas de diseño como la suite de Adobe, el general es buena, pero, por ejemplo, si utilizas Premiere y Aftter Effects al mismo tiempo se puede quedar pegada (pasmada) siendo que le falta algo de memoria. productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I was forced to buy a new computer with Windows 11.  My 10 year old Acer Aspire with wonderful Windows 10 got fried with a power surge.  I did have a surge protector, but the computer was old and I sorely miss it.  So I decided to buy another Acer Aspire and I did, but had to get Windows 11, which is the absolutely worst OS I have ever used and I started years ago with Windows 95 (one of the best) had most the other versions after that.  Windows 10 was by far one of the best.  The Acer computer is still a good computer, however they've made a weird revision by putting the ports underneath the screen so if you want to put something in a port you have to turn the computer upside down to put it in.  Not a good move on Acer's part, though the computer itself, so far is good.  I got it on June 10, 2026.  It's Widows 11 I'm unhappy with - it's like going back many years in OS with so many silly pop ups and hard to find anything on it without reading many instructions.  If you do a search it brings you to a website with pages of things to read.  Not happy with Windows 11 and I was hoping my old computer would last til Microsoft's next OS.  I would have changed altogether and go to a different OS other than Windows, but I'm old and all my old things I've saved for years is compatible with Windows.  I could actually still use my Windows 95 Office Suite program, which was before having to pay a yearly fee, on Windows 10.  Last October MS stopped support Windows 10 but I had a free one year support from MS so I knew it was time to move on but a power surge made the decision for me. I would recommend Acer computers as they last a long time, but Windows 11 is burdensome and frustrating.  P.S. I forget to mention the sound quality was so bad on the computer I had to buy external speakers.  I adjust the sound to the highest frequency it would go and the sound was still so low, new speakers were needed.  Sound works good with external speeakers.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Overall good especially for the price
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is a good price and really easy to install - there's a magnetic strip at the top that clings to the top of the screen. As other have noted, it does not automatically attach at the bottom...it comes with double-sided tape to hold it in place (which I'm not using). Provided the screen is tilted back at an angle, I don't feel I need the adhesive strips at the bottom. The privacy feature seems pretty effective...to me, better than some of the other review photos. The drawback with this and any privacy screen (I suspect) is that it does dim your screen so you need to increase the brightness to full in order to get good visibility. Also the privacy feature by nature makes the screen resolution less sharp. So as others have said, it's terrific if you're going to use it *on occasion* such as on flights, in coffee shops, or any place there are a lot of people and you want privacy. I will only use it for that and normally keep it in its protective sleeve when I'm at home or other places where privacy is no concern. Overall, I'd recommend it, with the caveats mentioned above, which may or may not be an issue for your particular needs and use.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Does what it’s supposed to do!Does what it’s supposed to do!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I’ve never used a privacy screen before but I was going on a work trip and felt it would be worth getting a privacy screen for working in public places.It arrived in perfect condition. I love that it’s magnetic on the top and it fits perfectly.It’s more thick than I thought but in a good way. It feels quite durable. It came with some things to stick it onto the screen as well as some cloths and a folder for traveling. I plan to only use it as a privacy screen so I don’t think I’ll actually stick it onto my computer as a long term screen protector but I feel it would be just fine for that!It dims the screen slightly but that’s kind of the point since it needs to hide the screen past a certain angle. It’s easy to wipe down with a dry cloth to get dust off.It looks nice on the computer since you can’t really tell anything is there. It feels durable and I’m confident it’ll last a long time.I’ve been using the plastic folder/sleeve to bring it with me. I just put it in the laptop slot of my backpack right behind the laptop itself. I did close it with the screen protector on just to see the gap other reviewers have mentioned. I think it’s so thin, it couldn’t be any thinner without sacrificing quality so the tiny gap didn’t bother me, however, since I didn’t use the adhesive, I needed to make sure the bottom part of the privacy screen (closer to the keyboard) didn’t fan out and get bent or stuck. But again, I plan to just use this by itself so I just end up taking the privacy screen off and putting it in the folder when I’m done using my MacBook.I’ve attached photos from the side angles and a video which shows the side views, then vertical (looking down towards the keyboard) and then right in front of the screen. You’ll see that there isn’t any privacy from a vertical point of view but the sides look completely dark!I would recommend this!Pros:Durable, high quality for the priceComes with adhesive, cloths, and a folderFits like a glove against the MacBook Pro 14” M2 Pro (A2779)Cons:I wish it could protect vertically and from a distance. The privacy only works on the sides. It’d be great to have something that can also protect from someone behind or above you.Please give this a try— you’ll likely find that it suits your needs as long as you’re aware of all the features!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I had some issues setting it up out of the box, but it was below zero temperatures the day it was delivered which may have contributed to that. Amazon support helped me quickly and I've had no issues since. After about a month of daily use, this all in one unit works great for work and grad school purposes. The unit is quite top heavy in comparison to the stand, so I got some heavy duty Velcro strips to secure it to my desk as it seemed likely to topple over if someone walked past too quickly or if the desk wobbles a bit. The mouse and keyboard that come with it work well and the background lighting is a cool feature. It takes up much less space than the old desktop w/CPU from years ago. No issues with Wi-Fi, sound, storage capacity or lagging. It's so quiet to the point that I wonder if there's a fan installed at all?? It's never felt warm so there must be something keeping it cool. There is a permanent meal sticker with customer service contact info featured quite prominently on the front of the unit. I wish this were removable or placed on the back of the unit, but that's really my only complaint. Excellent computer overall, especially for the price. I do not use it for gaming though, so I'm not sure how well equipped it is for that.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Nice product, well described Gaming PC, unresponsive customer service.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: EDIT: August 2025: This was previously a 5-star review but the lack of customer support with the Windows 11 rollout has forced me to change it.  Been using almost daily and still runs well. Had a couple of BSOD errors earlier this month (figuring that was part of the end of Windows 10). Customer service is actually nightmarishly impossible to reach, especially since this Windows 10/no updates announcement within the 1-year warranty. I'm now in the market for ANOTHER computer because of this - I wouldn't purchase another product of theirs.Bought for school because typing 8-10 page papers on my Macbook was just not working out anymore. A lot of the specs are comparable to iMac, and It’s a very good dupe for a 2019 or earlier iMac if you’re an Apple fan, and I came to the conclusion that it’s a prime candidate for a Hackintosh (if you’re into that sort of customization). I purchased the 1TB, 16gb, i7 processor version so I might try to hack it when summer rolls around, because I do miss my Mac.Out of the box setup is easy, and Windows 10 does have some sign on features that allow you to use your phone. I turned off Cortana immediately. Microsoft Edge is annoying, but usable enough to not download Safari or Chrome

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Perfect Starter Computer for My Daughter
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: My daughter has been begging me for a gaming station for months, and I was finally able to surprise her with this computer for Christmas! While it's not technically a "gaming" computer, it’s the perfect fit for her needs. She mostly plays simple games like Roblox, so this computer is more than enough to handle it without breaking the bank.The size of the computer is ideal for her new desk, and I love how everything is built into the monitor—super sleek and space-saving. But the best feature, hands down, is the light-up keyboard, mouse, and mouse pad! My daughter absolutely loves it, and it adds that extra touch of excitement to her setup.For the price and what we needed it for, this computer was perfect. I’m so glad we didn’t go for a thousand-dollar gaming PC. This is the ideal "starter" computer for her, and it makes me feel confident that we made the right choice.I couldn’t be happier with this purchase—great value and exactly what we needed. Five stars!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Solid Performance For Everyday UseSolid Performance For Everyday Use
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought this laptop mainly for everyday tasks like browsing and streaming but wanted something that could also handle light gaming on the side. The 1TB storage gives me plenty of room for games, files, and downloads without worrying about running out of space anytime soon. Startup and load times are fast thanks to the SSD, nothing feels sluggish even when switching between apps quickly.Battery life holds up fine for daily use around the house and the keyboard feels comfortable for long typing sessions. Wifi 6 keeps the connection stable even when streaming or downloading larger files. This has been a solid laptop for someone who wants one machine that handles both work and casual gaming without needing to buy two separate devices.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Good for browsing, but no dedicated graphics
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I think this is a good laptop for its price, but I can't recommend it without some kind of dedicated graphics. While this laptop can definitely browse the web and play movies, it will have big problems with any application that tries to display complicated graphics, like CAD programs. If you are in computer science or engineering for your college major, you need to look at a different buy, but otherwise this is okay. For me, I feel like 15.6" is a bit large, but that size allows for a number keypad, which is on this laptop. Just be careful, since the power button is in the corner of the keypad (above the ./Del key) and pressing that will turn off your PC unless you change it.Our of the box, this PC came with its charger and on a full charge it claimed to be able to last 10 hours. However, despite "10H" being shown in the battery estimate, this dropped to 90% after around 20 minutes, possibly because I was installing some software. I think that the actual battery life when using this laptop for medium-intensity tasks will turn out to be around 5 hours, half of what the absolute maximum is.The trackpad is pretty large, which is good, but I feel like the keyboard could have better ergonomics for typing. Additionally, I wish that the lid didn't pull up the bottom of the laptop when opening it. My other windows laptop doesn't do that, so it's a bit annoying that it happens with this one.This is still a good buy if you just need a computer to use, and it comes with a Windows software license on it, and it directly lets you set up a local account without needing to sign into Microsoft, but if you'll need anything that might involve graphics or AI, you'll want a laptop with a dedicated internal GPU and/or NPU.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on February 4, 2025

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great budget laptop and feels really nice
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Great budget laptop and it has USB C charging which is great because you don't have to have a certain charger for it. This laptop feels nice and has an AWESOME picture thanks to it's IPS display. This is a good computer for work or just browsing the internet, gaming on it though is lack luster no dedicated GPU in this laptop. The graphics are handled by the CPU so it's alright but for gaming you want a dedicated GPU.I love the fact that both the top plate and bottom plate on this laptop are an alloy metal and gives it some weight, I actually like the additional weight on a laptop it gives it a bit more presence in my mind.I did open it up to see about upgrades that you can do, I know that was a question when I bought it for me. It has a single DDR stick of RAM in it and that's it, I mean you could upgrade that to a single stick of 32GB RAM but still going to be in single channel mode. It has the typical slot for the NVME drive and no expansion slot so you can't put another NVME drive in there for storage.  Both the NVME and RAM sticks were off brand, but perform well.Oh the best part of this system is it's a bloat free version of Windows 11 installed, no third party apps and stuff like that to slow your system down, just your basic Windows 11 installed. I ran a program to make sure there was no malicious software installed and didn't find anything.Overall for the price it's a great budget laptop that feels good while using it. It's responsive enough to get work done and to get on the internet and watch YouTube and stuff like that.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on February 22, 2025

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Unexpected Ryzen 7 Upgrade Makes This Laptop a Steal!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I ordered this KAIGERR laptop because the specs looked great for the price, especially the 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, and the advertised Intel N97 processor. But when I received it, I found out it actually came with a Ryzen 7 5825U! That's a significantly more powerful processor, so I was pleasantly surprised. The laptop feels well-built, yet thin and light; and the 15.6-inch FHD screen is crisp and clear. Performance-wise, it's been fantastic for everyday tasks like browsing, word processing, streaming, and even some light photo editing. It handles multitasking without any slowdown, which is great. I haven't had any issues with the touchpad or anything else, so far.Now, it's a lesser-known brand, so I was initially a bit cautious. Some of the other reviews mentioned concerns about bloatware or spyware, but I haven't found anything suspicious on my machine. I ran some scans, and everything came back clean. I also checked the network activity, and nothing seemed out of the ordinary. Still, it's something to keep in mind if you're particularly security-conscious. It might be worth doing a clean install of Windows if you have any doubts. However, for me, everything has been running smoothly. The battery life has also been pretty decent, lasting me most of the day on a single charge.Overall, I'm extremely happy with this laptop, especially with the surprise Ryzen 7 upgrade. It's a fantastic value for the money, offering excellent performance and a great set of features. If you're looking for a powerful and affordable laptop, this one is definitely worth considering. The unexpected processor upgrade I received makes it an even better deal than advertised!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great laptop at a reasonable price
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I have been using computers since 1977 and have to say this is an excellent choice for a new or experienced user.  Setup was extremely easy. Connecting to my home network was a breeze. There seems to be no bloatware on this Windows 11 home edition installation. It was set up without creating an account using an instruction video found on the web. Everything works as it should, once you add the programs you prefer for work processing, accounting or just gaming. productPageReviews.reviewTitle: An Absolute Workhorse – The M5 Max is an Architecture
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I upgraded to this machine after holding onto an older Apple Silicon model, and the performance leap with the M5 Max is staggering. As someone whose daily work splits between editing 8K video timelines and running heavy local AI models, this laptop handles everything without even ramping up the fans.What stands out the most:The 48GB Sweet Spot: If you are on the fence between 36GB and stepping up to the Max tier, the 48GB of unified memory is the absolute sweet spot for power users. I can keep multiple Adobe apps open, cache complex motion graphics, and still have dozens of browser tabs active without a single hiccup or memory pressure warning.M5 Max Rendering Speed: Rendering times have effectively been cut in half. Effects that used to cause micro-stutters during real-time playback now stream perfectly smoothly. The local neural engine performance for AI upscaling and audio separation is blindingly fast.Thermal Efficiency & Battery Life: Apple has perfected the thermals here. Even during heavy exports, the chassis stays remarkably cool, and the battery drop-off is much more forgiving than any Windows workstation alternative. You can actually get real, heavy work done on an airplane without hunting for an outlet.The Display: The Liquid Retina XDR screen remains the best in the business. The contrast ratio and peak brightness make color-grading on the go incredibly accurate.The Verdict:Yes, it's a massive financial investment. But if time is money in your profession, the M5 Max with 48GB of RAM pays for itself in weeks. It is incredibly quiet, blisteringly fast, and refuses to slow down no matter what I throw at it.Highly recommended.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: I researched every laptop in this price rangeI researched every laptop in this price range
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Very happy with this laptop. I looked at multiple different models. Some users complained about crashing. I had 3 crashes after trying to download games through XBOX gamepass. I used Grok Build to identify the issue and it suggested disabling "Memory Integrity" in the windows system settings. After doing this I have not had any crashes.The performance of this laptop is really great. It's snappy and boots quickly. There's no system slow down whatsoever. On a fresh boot the laptop is responsive and ready to go. It comes with a dedicated RTX 5050 8GB, which is really the big selling point of this laptop. The laptop only has 16gb of non-upgradeable ram, however, because it has a dedicated GPU, when gaming or using apps that can access your GPU, you get a bonus 8gb of ram. This is also accessible when using apps with hardware acceleration. This is very different from a laptop with 16gb of ram and an iGPU. The backend allocates resources effectively to give you an optimal experience. This does come at a cost of more power utilization, and is not as effective as having 32gb of dedicated RAM, but it isn't 'nothing'. That RTX5050 is also giving you access to DLSS and frame-gen in games, and when compared to even the best iGPU like a B390, still beats it by 50% in rasterization. The keyboard area is relatively cool, even under load. I've used and returned laptops in the past because the keyboard area gets so insanely hot. If you're also sensitive to that I would not worry.The screen quality is very good. After downloading AMD Adrenaline I was able to adjust the colors to my preference. The Lenovo Advantage app has display color profiles you can choose from to set the base color profile for the screen. I suggest doing that first. I'm using DCIP, as in my opinion that is the best profile for media consumption. From there you can go into Adrenaline and adjust the saturation, contrast, brightness to what looks good to you. The screen is glossy, but this isn't a big deal on this laptop. Even on a black screen. Yes, you can see your reflection, but it's no worse than your phone. I actually use a matte OLED monitor for my desktop because gloss bothers me, but I'm not bothered on this.The battery life is.... well it's a windows laptop. The AMD CPU is great, but it's not a core ultra. Lenovo Advantage has battery profiles you can use for best performance, best battery life and somewhere in between. If you are at max brightness and 120hz, watching youtube, browsing twitter, playing some games, you could get 2 hours to 4 hours. People have reported 10 hours at 60hz, medium brightness with power saving settings turned on. With the included laptop charger it charges from 10% to full while in use at max performance settings in about an hour. The battery is 84w. As I'm writing this at 120hz and 75% screen brightness battery usage is at 15w.  However, of that 15w, 5w to 8w is being used by the idle gpu. That's in its lowest power state, a resting state, so that it can start up when needed. The gpu in balanced mode tops at 45w. In Geek mode (plugged in) it tops at 90w. The max TDP is 105w, which you need MSI Afterburner to do. Real use case: Unplugged Battery Saver mode for work/school will last you 8 hours browsing, typing, youtube. There's a Adaptive Power mode that you can leave the laptop on and it will adjust your power use throughout the day. The laptop only accepts a 65w+ type-c charger over 20v, so a normal phone charger does not work.  However, you can get a 20v charger that works on phones and laptops for less than $20 and it looks exactly like a cellphone charger. You don't need a big brick charger. For $40 you can get a 20v 100w charger. Definitely worth getting as a backup. The charging brick the laptop comes with uses a proprietary plug that looks like a USB-A but smaller, and that does 170w over 20v. You can tell if a charging brick can charge this laptop by looking at the text on a charging brick and looking for "20v".Overall, this is a VERY good value laptop. For under $1100 you get: OLED + 1800p + 120hz + RTX5050. It also has a full-size keyboard with numpad which is VERY nice. The SSD is upgradeable AND there's a 2nd unoccupied m.2 2280 slot, so you can add a 1tb/2tb/4tb drive., anything higher might be too thick for the chassis. I highly recommend this laptop.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The Sceptre 34-Inch Curved Ultrawide WQHD Monitor has been a fantastic addition to my setup, and after owning it for two years, I can confidently say it’s been reliable and well worth it.The 3440 × 1440 ultrawide resolution looks fantastic and gives you a ton of screen real estate. Whether I’m multitasking, gaming, or just browsing, everything looks sharp. I’ve had zero issues with the resolution or display quality during the entire time I’ve owned it. The R1500 curve also makes a noticeable difference—it pulls the edges of the screen into your field of view.Build quality has held up well over time, and I’ve had no reliability issues after two years of regular use. For the price, the features you get—ultrawide WQHD, high refresh rate, and good color reproduction—make this monitor a strong value.The only real downside is the power/menu button design. The button is located on the bottom of the monitor and acts as an all-in-one control for power, menu, and navigation. It works, but it can be a bit awkward and unintuitive to use, especially when you’re trying to quickly adjust settings.Pros• Owned for 2 years with no issues• Sharp 3440 × 1440 ultrawide resolution• Smooth 165–180Hz refresh rate• 1ms response time• Good color with 99% sRGB• Excellent value for the priceCons• Single bottom button for power and menu navigation can be awkwardOverall, if you’re looking for an affordable ultrawide monitor with great performance and reliability, this Sceptre model is a solid choice. After two years of use, it’s still performing exactly as expected.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: FANTASTIC TECH SUPPORT ON A QUALITY PRODUCT
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I purchased two of these 34 inch 4K curved  monitors to use in my home office environment.  I have multiple windows open at the same time, and using a single 42" monitor still didn't give me the flexibility I wanted, hence two of these.They arrived yesterday and firstly, I have recently purchased monitors online only to have them arrive with a cracked screen. These are very well packaged and were perfect out of the box. That said, assembly of the simple but effective stand was three screws and all done.  Very stable on my work surface.  I am using a Windows 11 Pro laptop that has all the bells and whistles, and connect external devices through a hub / port.  Now, here is why my review has the headline as you see it.After hooking everything up (power and HDMI and you're done), and booting my computer, I had one display that was gorgeous with 4K resolution, and the other so blurry I couldn't read it at 640x480 resolution.  ??  It goes without saying that all of my Bios, drivers, and connections were solid, cables were good, etc.  Windows would not let me select a resolution on the second monitor - it was all grayed out.  I tried the monitor setup button itself - no joy as the resolution is controlled by the computer graphics card.  I re-booted, I swapped cables, still no joy.  Obviously this is a simple user-error, but it was really late in the day and beyond me to figure it out.I called the toll free number for Tech Support that was in the setup guide, and they have hours until early evening PST (I'm EST) so that was good.  And then - after going through the call directory for Tech Support I got the dreaded recording "All agents are assisting other customers.  You  may leave a message or try again later."  Yeah - right; we've all heard that before.  So, I left a message that I needed setup help, my name and number, and went downstairs to fix some dinner.Here's the incredible part, and the First Shock.  Less than 15 minutes and my cell rings and it is Sceptre Tech Support!  Not a robot - a person!  I went back to my home office, and started by telling the very polite young man (who spoke impeccable English) that I had just unboxed these and had not even registered them yet.  Second Shock - he didn't put me through name, address, email, phone, model, serial number, and the rest of the gamut that is normal.  He simply asked what my problem was and what I had tried.  We walked through that, changed around one connection, re-booted, and all was perfect!  Third Shock - he stayed with me through it all, made sure I could shut down and start up without difficulty or change in display quality, confirmed monitor settings for my usage profile, and then took some extra time to tell me about features I had seen in the user guide that might be beneficial for me given my use, and walked me through those as well.I can promise you I will tell this story again and again.  Beyond that, I'm going to look at everything this company sells and - if I have a need - I will buy their products.  Those of you in the electronics world will understand how extraordinary this level of customer interaction is in today's world. I wish I had this person's name, as he deserves the accolades, but he didn't give it - he just was there to help.Wow . . .

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Excellent 4K Value That Does Everything Well
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I picked up the Philips 27E1N5900R as a daily driver for a mix of office productivity, coding, media consumption, and console gaming, and it handles all of it without breaking a sweat.The image quality is excellent for the price point. 4K at 27 inches gives you a sharp, clean picture whether you're staring at lines of code late at night or unwinding with a game on the console. Colors are accurate, text is crisp, and the IPS panel means viewing angles aren't an issue at a desk setting. It's comfortable to work at for long stretches without scaling adjustments.I'm using both HDMI and USB-C connections, which makes swapping between devices seamless. USB-C in particular is a nice quality-of-life feature; one cable for video and charging keeps the desk clean.The stand deserves a mention. It's firm, stable, and has survived two moves without any wobble or looseness. That says a lot about the build quality. Plenty of monitor stands start to feel flimsy after one trip in a moving box. This one held up.For what you're paying, getting a legitimate 4K IPS panel with USB-C connectivity and solid build quality is a genuine bargain. There are flashier monitors out there with higher refresh rates and more gaming-centric features, but if you need a reliable everyday 4K display that handles work, code, media, and casual gaming equally well, this Philips punches well above its price.

So if you want to plug in a 4K HDMI device, you will need, at minimum, an HDMI-to-DisplayPort adapter.  Probably a powered adapter. I have one to use my Apple TV 4K HDMI to DisplayPort.  DisplayPort to DisplayPort works fine.  The menu buttons are horrible, and the menus are clunky at best, but it is not much worse than most.On the good side, the graphics quality is good.  After messing around with the settings, the color gets sort of close to my LG 4k, but the LG display is more than twice the price.  For me, this is a second monitor I will use to move things out of the way but still be able to see them.  Mainly text.  The monitor is OK and worth the money if you are just going to plug it into a DisplayPort.  In my case, I had to buy extra cables and a DisplayPort switch, so it ended up not being that great of a bargain.  The 1440 HDMI interface sucks.  That should be in the description.  It is a BIG deal.UPDATE:  This monitor DOES support HDMI 2.0 4K @ 60Hz.  BUT you need proper cables rated at 4 K @ 60Hz or above.  I suggest getting 8K cables.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Good: There's no denying this thing wins in terms of size; over 4 sqf (3775cm^3) of screen space is just beyond belief and a boon for someone with poor eyesight who can't handle tiny images.  The colour is pretty great, too - I've never seen a high-refresh rate monitor with zero gradient banding for this price range before.  No problems driving it all the way to 165Hz.  It's super clean - all RGB can be turned off and there's no glowing logo or anything.Bad: The backlight is so uneven and bleed-ey it is a joke in dark scenes.  The curve is a really unnatural shape and extremely distracting if anything crosses the midpoint of the monitor.  The viewing angle is a joke; it gets washed out even slightly off axis, and this matters when a screen is so large that you are inherently looking at the edges from an angle if you're not sitting several feet away.  The thing is so heavy I genuinely fear for the integrity of my desk.Meh: the OSD is neither the best nor worst I've used; lots of confusing game/mode options that could be simplified.  Has 1 DP and 2 HDMI; wish that was the other way around since most of my GPUs have more DP than HDMI.  Can't connect as a display over just USB-C.  The brightness skews towards being much, much too bright; I have to run it at like 17/50 to be able to look at it for more than a few minutes.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great computer. EXTREMELY EASY to remove S ModeGreat computer. EXTREMELY EASY to remove S Mode
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I feel the need to counter the most popular review here because it is misleading to new customers, and could potentially prevent them from buying a great little computer. If all you want to do is browse the internet and stream Netflix, etc, this is the perfect computer. Please note that you likely won't be able to play many games or use video editing/other resource-intensive software on this thing, that's not what this is for.To remove "S Mode" (aka safety mode), all you need to do is go to your Start Menu, type "s mode", and follow the instructions. It's so easy to set up. You only need to do this once! See images.All S Mode does is prevent the user from downloading any program that isn't on the Microsoft store. Most people don't want that, and the computer doesn't function as expected with it on - to someone familiar with computers, it doesn't behave like a computer!*However*, I wish this setting was around while my grandfather was alive. He didn't understand that downloading random slot machine games from unvetted sites could expose him to viruses. If he were locked into only downloading from the Microsoft store, it would have saved 2 computers he destroyed.So: if you're familiar with computers and are looking for something blazing fast that's lightweight and can handle Microsoft Office programs, browsers, and video streaming without issue, this is the one for you. Screen is great, battery life is great, and charging through a USB-C port is incredibly convenient (assuming your phone charger is a decent wattage, you can charge your computer with that, too!). I got it here for less than $300 and it was a steal.And, as I said, if you have someone in your life who would like to use a computer but isn't familiar with the dangers of downloading programs from shady websites, S Mode could be of genuine value to you. My grandfather even fell victim to a computer lock-out scam towards the end of his life that cost him hundreds to resolve. Something to consider.

By itself, it's a little underpowered. The RAM is supposedly not be upgradable because the RAM is hardwired to the motherboard.  8 GB of ram is totally fine for this anyway.  This isn’t a creator computer by any means.  The 128GB M.2 ssd drive is replaceable. I have a 1TB M.2 drive to replace it with.  It comes with Windows Home in S mode, but anytime you want you can flip a software switch in windows and it becomes regular Windows 11 home.  This is not reversable however, so make sure you really don’t want the S mode version.  (You can do your own research on S mode)  Now you have a fine laptop, fully decked out for home computing and browsing use.  You can’t beat it for $279 plus a little extra if you want a larger ssd stick.

The AI Picture Optimizer adapts the visuals for optimal quality whether working, gaming, or watching videos. SmartThings enables control of connected devices, turning the monitor into a central IoT hub via mobile or voice command. Knox Security keeps data safe and confidential, plus it enhances the security of IoT connections made through the Smart Monitor. The 4K UHD display brings content to life in vivid detail with incredible clarity. Active Voice Amplifier adapts to noisy environments and automatically adjusts volume. Click-to-Search offers content details. Gaming Hub enables access to the biggest games from top streaming partners with no PC or console needed.¹Features, services and app availability may vary by country and region. Samsung TV Plus and Universal Guide may not be available in some regions. Some features may require separate subscriptions. The user interface is subject to change without notice. This Smart Monitor does not include a TV tuner, which is not necessary for streaming apps. Internet connection is required. Remote control specifications vary by country and region. Keyboard and mouse control compatibility varies by app. Access to the full range of smart features, such as network-based services, applications (including games and streaming services), and smart home functionality, requires a Samsung Account. Without logging in, functionality is limited to external devices, e.g. via HDMI. You can sign up for a free Samsung Account at https://account.samsung.com. Terms and conditions apply. ²
features: INSTANT ACCESS TO YOUR FAVORITE STREAMING CONTENT: Stream content directly from your monitor, or tune into Samsung TV Plus to get live channels and on-demand content.¹

OPTIMALLY TAILORED VISUALS WITH AI: Experience optimal picture quality adjusted to your needs.² AI Picture Optimizer adapts the visuals to help you work on documents with comfort, get fully immersed in games with deep and rich blacks.

SIMPLE CONTROL FOR YOUR SMART HOME: See your smart home devices in a 3D Map View and manage them with ease.³ You can also check the energy usage and cost by device, and save money by putting them in energy-saving modes.

YOUR PRIVACY. SECURED ON SAMSUNG MONITORS: Keep your monitor data safe and confidential with Samsung Knox.⁴ Its robust, multi-layered security and tightly controlled access also enhance the security of your IoT connections made through your Smart Monitor.

ENJOY YOUR CONTENT IN VIVID DETAIL: Watch your content come to life with incredible clarity.⁵ 4K UHD resolution enhances even fine details in images and videos, making worlds feel more vibrant and realistic.

ADAPTS TO NOISY ENVIRONMENTS: Hear words clearly with AI technology.⁶ Active Voice Amplifier analyzes background noise around the monitor and automatically adjusts the volume of your content, so you can catch dialogue effortlessly - even in loud settings.

DISCOVER WHAT’S ON YOUR SCREEN: Enrich your viewing experience with Click to Search.⁸ With just a click, you’ll instantly get content recommendations and details on what you’re watching - so you can explore actors’ biographies, filmographies and more.

WHERE GAMING COMES TOGETHER: Access the ultimate gaming realm.⁹ In the Samsung Gaming Hub, you can play the biggest games from top streaming partners, with no PC or console needed. Discover new games or replay old favorites all in one place.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Probably good for some users but not as a simple external laptop monitor.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This monitor tries to be everything at once: a computer monitor, a streaming device, a gaming display, and more. If that’s what you’re looking for, you might enjoy it. I just want a simple computer monitor—and that’s where this falls apart.The built-in operating system interferes aggressively with basic monitor behavior. Instead of automatically displaying my laptop when I plug it in, I have to use the remote every single time to tell it to switch inputs. It’s slow, annoying, and completely unnecessary for a product marketed as a monitor.It includes a built-in USB-A hub for a mouse and keyboard, but in my setup the monitor takes control of the mouse and will not pass it through to the computer at all. I had to plug the mouse directly into my laptop to use it. By comparison, I have an LG monitor with multiple inputs and a USB hub that simply stays on the selected input until I tell it otherwise—no fighting the software.To make matters worse, there are no physical controls for brightness, contrast, or color. The picture quality is acceptable, but it’s overly bright and lacks contrast, and I can’t adjust it without using software or downloading an app. I’m not interested in installing an app just to control basic monitor settings that should be accessible on the device itself.Because of the constant friction caused by the smart OS and the lack of basic physical controls, this monitor gets a low rating from me. If you want a “smart TV–monitor hybrid,” this might work. If you want a straightforward computer monitor, look elsewhere.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Superó mis expectativas como monitor para PC
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Estoy complétamente satisfecho con esta compra. La compré por dos razones. La primera es que estaba buscando un monitor grande de 32" como éste. Vengo de usar durante muchos años monitores de 24" full hd, pero mi trabajo me exije estar gran parte del día leyendo en pantalla y escribiendo en procesador de textos, por lo que ya me estaba resultando cada vez más cansado leer en la compu, y prefería la tableta. Mi intención era comprar la versión m5 de este monitor, que es full hd, sin embargo al leer las reviews e informarme sobre los aspectos técnicos, tuve que declinar esa opción porque hubiera sido un retroceso debido a la cantidad de distribución de píxeles en una pantalla grande (al parecer iba a ser más cansado a la vista por la nitidez de las letras). Estaba a punto de optar por un monitor de 27", o uno de 32 qhd cuando di con esta opción. El salto al 4k es enorme. La nitidez de las letras es excelente, y ahora puedo trabajar con varios documentos abiertos a la vez, lo que aumenta a la productividad.Mucha gente se queja por el brillo. En mi opinión es perfecto. Pude configurar el brillo sin problemas, así como el hdr en juegos (aclaro, soy jugador casual, nada de gamer y esas cosas), y la verdad es que los colores se ven vívidos. También puedo cambiar a modo protección de la vista, y otro modo de atenuación automática, según lo que se ve en pantalla, para no cansar la vista, y aunque no lo crean la funcionalidad es muy buena. Cuando pongo películas fullhd o 4k la vívides y contraste de los colores es muy agradable, con negros profundos. Así que en cuestión imagen no tengo ninguna queja (conecto el monitor a través de HDMI).La segunda razón por la cual decidí comprar este monitor es que tiene dos puertos HDMI, uno de los cuales es HDMI EARC. Esta característica por sí sola es muy difícil de encontrar en monitores para PC (sólo es una característica presente en las smart TV). Investigando me di cuenta que ni siquiera los monitores LG equivalentes a este Samsung incluyen el puerto HDMI Arc (sólo dos puertos HDMI 2.1). La razón por la que considero importante esta característica es que la mayoría de los home theaters y barras de sonido traen conectividad HDMI arc (incompatible con HDMI normal), e interfaz toslink. Tengo un home theater Sony HT -S40r y no podía sacar el potencial completo al conectarlo a la computadora. La única forma en la que podía hacerlo era por bluetooth (desaconsejable por que es una calidad muy inferior a conectarlo por cable), y cable toslink (algo poco común en las pcs de hoy en día, y además el ancho de banda que transmite el cable óptico es inferior). Intenté con extractores de audio HDMI, y no tuve suerte. En cambio, con este monitor por fin pude conectar la PC a mi home theater, y con la aplicación Dolby Access he podido sacar el audio como siempre quise hacerlo (con cable toslink sólo es posible sacar audio Dolby comprimido, y no es compatible con el códec de Home Theater de Dolby Access). La sensación que experimento ahora es completamente envolvente, no sólo cuando pongo una película 5.1, sino también un hacer upmix estéreo más que aceptable, algo que a los puristas audiófilos no les gusta, pero quién disfruta de escuchar música de manera inmersiva, como si estuviera en un automóvil es la solución ideal (antes podía hacer upmix estéreo, pero no podía sacar un audio que me convenciera de los parlantes traseros, por lo general era más bajo).El único pero que le pongo al monitor es justamente todas las opciones smart (y por lo que se promociona). Para mí son innecesarias teniendo todo conectado al PC, y todo lo que pide para la instalación (registro, conexión a internet, y demás se me hizo tedioso. Pero por todo lo demás creo que fue un golazo estirar un poco mi presupuesto y adquirir este monitor.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Buy this if you love high pitched screams and dull screens... otherwise, don't.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I used this for about a week and ended up having to return it.  The monitor was nice looking on the desk and the connectivity options were good, but that's it.  It had had a bad glare even with no uncovered window and most of the lighting in the room coming from behind it.  The picture quality was not great no matter what adjustments I made.  Colors were dull and lighting was poor.  Both of the computers I hooked up have great graphics, so I thought maybe something was getting lost along the way and I needed to try different cables, ports, etc. - nope.  Hooked them up to a different monitor using all of the same connection methods, and got super clear, crisp colors... not dull like this one was.  I tried every way to like this because the price was great, the reviews were good, and the specs were supposedly good too, but it was not good at all.****BUT the thing that made me decide it HAD to go back was the sound!!!****  It had SUCH a bad high-pitched whine no matter what I connected, how I adjusted settings, etc.!  I thought it would go away or tried troubleshooting once again hoping maybe was a connection issue, but stripped down to it's barest connections, with the best cables, and across every device I tried it with, the whine was still there.  It seemed to be the loudest around the monitor's power adapter, but it was practically a scream, so it didn't really matter what part of the thing it was coming from.  Again, totally gone now that I have a different monitor connected, so the monitor was definitely the culprit.Save yourself the trouble of a bulky return package, and pass on this monitor!  I have Samsung, HP, Apple, Lenovo, and LG monitors.  None have these issues.  I use the set up where this monitor was for work, gaming, graphic design, and streaming - on both a Mac and a PC, so this monitor got a pretty fair shot at everything.  The one I replaced this monitor with is a fairly spec equivalent LG that is also a smart TV, and it was only $120 more.  I'm sure there are other similar options out there for probably even closer to this price without the tv options.  Buy one of those... don't buy this one!{{Side note for anyone still reading this very long review... someone told me recently that "-" is a sign of AI generated text.  Not AI.  I just like "-" LOL!!}}

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Two failed monitors, a problematic seller, bad directions from amazon. Lesson learned stay FAR away.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Well at first this monitor worked great. For about 48 hours. I turn my monitors off at night when I am not at work so they can rest and no risk of screen burn overnight. I also have screen savers set to set in 30 mins after no activity.The first monitor I had worked great until I turned it on on day 3 and the screen just flashed colors. Red, blue, green, black, gray and cycled through them. Didnt matter what input I used on the monitor, DVI or HDMi port did the same. Swapped outputs on my video card, same result. Tested with 3 other monitors I have and no problem. Test with my laptop on this monitor, same problem of rotating colors. Mind you I built my PC 2 years ago and have never had a problem like this. I turn it off and on 10x or so, and eventually it goes back to normal and displays my desktop.I message Amazon, they are very apologetic as usual. They send a second one and I agree to send back the first one or be charged. 24 hours later my second replacement one displays pixel lines all over the screen that looks like 1" by 1" graph paper. An even more annoying problem than the original "rotating color screen."I message amazon again and they say that I am fine to dispose of the second one and they will have me contact the seller directly to have them send a new one. Amazon chat directs me to "dispose" of the first one as the seller has the ability to send a replacement and should with no problem.I have gone back and fourth for a week and a half with the seller, and they keep asking me to return the one I was already told to dispose of. Mistake on my part for listening to amazon and throwing it away.The seller, has been less than helpful at best. Amazon has been moderately helpful but also put me in this situation. This was a waste of a month to see how a $200 monitor would work out. Simply put, I would have paid 2 or 3x the price for one that just worked right the first time as this has been quite a pain. Which is what I wound up doing. I bought one locally at Micro Center so if I had any issues still I could just deal with it locally.I was hopeful given the reviews, that this would be a great deal but I've wound up typing more and taking more pictures of two broken monitors than I have ever wanted. This was a massive waste of time and I'm still getting charged for one of the monitors that I disposed of because now I cant return it. Lesson learned, avoid the seller and the product.

description: The 27-inch TUF Gaming VG27UQ1A 4K UHD gaming monitor featuring a Fast IPS panel and NVIDIA® G-SYNC® Compatible for blistering-fast 160 Hz gaming. Its clever combination of Display Stream Compression (DSC), ASUS Extreme Low Motion Blur Sync (ELMB Sync) and AMD FreeSync™ Premium technologies enables buttery-smooth gaming on PCs. aPlusContent.title: From the manufacturer
aPlusContent.rawText:
From the manufacturer

ASUS is recognized as one of Fortune magazine’s World’s Most Admired Companies. It stands as one of the top motherboard and gaming brands and is also a top-three consumer notebook vendor. The company is driven by passion and innovation, dedicated to creating quality products for a future smart life. ASUS designs and manufactures products that perfectly meet the needs of today's digital homes, offices, and individuals. 
TUF Gaming VG27UQ1A 
TUF Gaming VG27UQ1A Gaming Monitor – 27 inch 4K, HDR, 160Hz, ELMB Sync, 1ms response time, 95% DCI-P3, DisplayWidget Center, AMD FreeSync Premium, NVIDIA G-SYNC Compatible 
27-inch 4K (3840 x 2160) gaming monitor with ultra-fast 160Hz refresh rate designed for professional gamers and immersive gameplay 
ASUS Extreme Low Motion Blur Sync (ELMB Sync) technology enables ELMB and variable-refresh-rate technologies to work simultaneously to eliminate ghosting and tearing for sharp gaming visuals with high frame rates 
NVIDIA G-SYNC Compatible, AMD FreeSync Premium, and exclusive Variable Overdrive technology ensure seamless, tear-free gaming 
High dynamic range (HDR) technology and 95% DCI-P3 professional color gamut provide amazing color performance 
160Hz REFRESH RATE AND 1MS (GTG) RESPONSE TIME 
The liquid crystal elements in the ASUS Fast IPS display switches up to 4X faster than conventional IPS panels for swifter response, allowing you to enjoy the latest fast-paced games in all their glory with supersmooth lag-free visuals, even at the highest display settings. 
ADAPTIVE-SYNC 
AMD FreeSync Premium, NVIDIA G-Sync compatible and VESA AdaptiveSync technology ensure supersmooth, tear-free visuals with low latency. 
High Dynamic Range 
TUF Gaming VG27UQ1A takes advantage of HDR technology to deliver more vivid colors and higher contrast levels compared to traditional monitors. 
ELMB Sync 
ELMB Sync* software that enables ELMB to work simultaneously with adaptive-sync technology to eliminate ghosting and tearing for extraordinarily sharp, high-frame-rate gaming. 
*Ideal for Fast-paced games , works better over 85Hz. 
Variable Overdrive 
Integrated ASUS Variable Overdrive technology allows the display to dynamically alter its overdrive setting as frame rates fluctuate, ensuring optimal results for any game. You choose how strong you want the overall effect to be, then let the monitor take it from there. 
Shadow Boost 
ASUS Shadow Boost technology clarifies dark areas of the game without overexposing brighter areas, improving overall viewing while also making it easier to spot enemies hidden in dark areas of the map. 
GamePlus 
The ASUS-exclusive, integrated GamePlus hotkey offers in-game enhancements that help you get more out of your game. This function is co-developed with input from pro gamers, allowing them to practice and improve their gaming skills. 
LOW BLUE LIGHT 
ASUS Low Blue Light technology reduces the amount of potentially harmful blue light emitted by the display. Four different filter settings are available to control the amount of blue light reduction. 
Extensive Connectivity 
A multitude of connectivity options, including two HDMI 2.1, plus DisplayPort 1.4 (DSC), ensures wide compatibility with a variety of input sources.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Amazing value for the priceAmazing value for the price
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I absolutely love this monitor! I got the 27 inch 4K Monitor. I use this for my Xbox Series X as I saw it has HDMI 2.1. Everything works great for me. The monitor set up was very quick and easy as they give you the tools necessary in a little bag. The instructions are very clear with pictures. Make sure to use an HDMI 2.1 cable and then enable 4K, variable refresh rate and 120hz if you’re using console in your settings so that you’re getting the best quality. Playing Black Ops 7 on this monitor has totally enhanced my gameplay. I’m noticing it’s easier to track moving targets and I’m seeing enemies from a farther distance than before. Also, going through menus I noticed the text is crystal clear now. I was in the market for a new monitor and this was a huge upgrade for me. I recommended this monitor to all of my friends who game. Definitely try to play around in the settings with brightness contrast and saturation. They also have plenty of preset color modes to choose from as well. I don’t use the preset modes as I prefer to set my own.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Punches above it's weightPunches above it's weight
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: **Excellent Value 4K Gaming Monitor - Hard to Beat at This Price**The VG27UQ1A has been a pleasant surprise. Its price-to-performance ratio makes it an exceptional value. I picked it up for $280, and it’s surprisingly feature-rich for its price point.**Key features:*** 4K resolution - ✅* HDR support - ✅* 120Hz refresh rate - ✅Finding a monitor that checks *all three* boxes for under $300 is nearly impossible.Pros:* Impressive specs for the price* No dead or stuck pixels out of the box* Solid color accuracy* Multiple HDMI 2.1 ports - great for console and PC use* Ideal for multi-device setupsCons:* Built-in speakers are poor - comparable to a phone speaker (expected, but worth noting)* Slightly bulky; not the thinnest design, though bezels are reasonably slim* Stand is basic with limited ergonomics (not an issue if you're using a monitor arm, like I am)Are there better monitors out there? Sure.But are there better gaming monitors with these features and specs under $300? That’s a much harder find.If you're shopping on a mid-range budget, this monitor punches above its weight. You're essentially getting upper mid-range performance at a lower mid-range price. If you DON'T need 240Hz refresh rate, then I'd highly recommend.

breadCrumbs: Electronics > Computers & Accessories > Monitors
description: Samsung’s 32” M8 Smart Monitor, with the NQM AI Processor and featuring 4K UHD resolution, delivers an AI-powered experience. Smart TV Apps provide instant access to your favorite content. The processor upscales lower-resolution content to 4K, while the AI Picture Optimizer adapts visuals for optimal quality whether you're working, gaming, or watching videos. Knox Security protects your data and enhances the safety of your IoT connections through tightly controlled access. Click-to-Search provides instant content details. Gaming Hub gives access to the biggest games from top streaming partners with no PC or console required. One UI Tizen, powered by Samsung Tizen OS, provides a personalized screen experience for you to take advantage of the latest Samsung features. Active Voice Amplifier Pro uses advanced audio processing to ensure dialogue comes through clearly. SmartThings enables control of connected devices, turning your monitor into a central IoT hub. The SlimFit Camera attaches to the monitor and provides clear picture quality. The ergonomically designed stand supports comfortable viewing with height adjustment, tilt, and pivot capabilities. Multiple ports, including USB-C, HDMI, and USB-A, make connectivity simple.
features: INSTANT ACCESS TO YOUR FAVORITE STREAMING CONTENT: Stream content directly from your monitor, or tune into Samsung TV Plus to get live channels and on-demand content.¹

OPTIMALLY TAILORED VISUALS WITH AI: Experience optimal picture quality adjusted to your needs.² AI Picture Optimizer adapts the visuals to help you work on documents with comfort, get fully immersed in games with deep and rich blacks.

SIMPLE CONTROL FOR YOUR SMART HOME: See your smart home devices in a 3D Map View and manage them with ease.³ You can also check the energy usage and cost by device, and save money by putting them in energy-saving modes.

YOUR PRIVACY. SECURED ON SAMSUNG MONITORS: Keep your monitor data safe and confidential with Samsung Knox.⁴ Its robust, multi-layered security and tightly controlled access also enhance the security of your IoT connections made through your Smart Monitor.

ENJOY YOUR CONTENT IN VIVID DETAIL: Watch your content come to life with incredible clarity.⁵ 4K UHD resolution enhances even fine details in images and videos, making worlds feel more vibrant and realistic.

ADAPTS TO NOISY ENVIRONMENTS: Hear words clearly with AI technology.⁶ Active Voice Amplifier analyzes background noise around the monitor and automatically adjusts the volume of your content, so you can catch dialogue effortlessly - even in loud settings.

DISCOVER WHAT’S ON YOUR SCREEN: Enrich your viewing experience with Click to Search.⁸ With just a click, you’ll instantly get content recommendations and details on what you’re watching - so you can explore actors’ biographies, filmographies and more.

WHERE GAMING COMES TOGETHER: Access the ultimate gaming realm.⁹ In the Samsung Gaming Hub, you can play the biggest games from top streaming partners, with no PC or console needed. Discover new games or replay old favorites all in one place.

CONNECT WITH CONVENIENCE: Connect your gadgets without any adapters. With USB-C, HDMI and USB-A ports, you can charge your device, transmit data, and make the most out of your multi-screen setup - all at once.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great Picture and Plenty of Screen Space
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought this monitor for my wife, and she absolutely loves it. The 32-inch screen gives you plenty of room to work or stream, and the picture quality is sharp, bright, and very clear. Everything looks crisp without needing much setup.What really stands out is the size. The extra screen space makes a big difference whether you're multitasking, watching videos, or just browsing. The built-in speakers are decent, but they're probably the weakest part of the monitor. They get the job done for everyday use, but don't expect amazing sound. That said, it wasn't a deal breaker for us.Overall, this has been a great purchase. The display looks fantastic, the size is perfect, and my wife couldn't be happier with it. If you're looking for a quality smart monitor with a beautiful screen, this is an easy recommendation.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: 5 Months In, USB-C Dead and Samsung Won't Fix It
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I purchased this monitor 5 months ago as an external monitor for my Mac. The USB-C connection stopped working out of the blue -- no changes to my setup, no drops, no damage. I've tried multiple USB-C cables and multiple ports with no success.I can connect via HDMI, but HDMI doesn't support the camera -- which is a major selling point of this monitor -- and caps the picture at 1080p instead of the advertised 4K. So I'm paying for a 4K + camera monitor and using it as a basic 1080p screen.After several hours with Samsung support, they couldn't fix it and want me to ship the monitor in for repairs -- potentially weeks without it -- despite the fact that I rely on it daily for work. Samsung's warranty offers in-home service but they're refusing to honor it.For the price, this is completely unacceptable.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: A beast of a laptop – premium price, premium performance
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I wanted a desktop replacement for gaming, 3D modeling, and some heavy multitasking. This ASUS delivered on all fronts.The 18-inch 240Hz display is absolutely gorgeous – colors pop, motion is buttery smooth, and the 2560x1600 resolution is sharp for both gaming and productivity work. The RTX 5070 Ti handles everything I've thrown at it without breaking a sweat. High settings on demanding games, smooth frame rates, and ray tracing with no noticeable hit to performance. It's a significant upgrade from my previous laptop.The Intel Ultra 9 is incredibly snappy, and with 32GB of DDR5 RAM, I never hit slowdowns – even with multiple apps open alongside a game. The 2TB SSD provides plenty of space for my game library and project files.I also appreciate the thermal performance. The laptop runs warm under heavy load, but the fans keep it well-controlled without being too loud. The RGB keyboard is comfortable and customizable, though I tend to keep it subtle for a cleaner look.One thing to keep in mind: it's large and not the lightest laptop out there. If you need portability, this might not be the best fit. But if you're looking for a stationary gaming and productivity powerhouse, this is a great choice.Overall, highly recommended for gamers and professionals who want top-tier performance in a laptop form factor.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The Alienware 18 Area-51 is an incredible machine. It feels less like a traditional laptop and more like a powerful desktop gaming PC that you can actually take with you.Performance is excellent. I play demanding games at maximum settings, and it handles them extremely well. The large 18-inch display makes gaming incredibly immersive, and everything feels smooth and responsive.One of the things that impressed me the most is the cooling system. It does an amazing job, and the Stealth Mode is fantastic. Even when playing demanding games at high settings, the laptop manages to stay surprisingly cool and quiet. I honestly didn’t expect a machine this powerful to handle heat and fan noise this well.The RGB lighting is absolutely top-notch and looks amazing, especially in the dark. The touchpad is another highlight — easily one of the coolest touchpads I’ve used on a gaming laptop.The only real downside is the size and weight. This thing is BIG and heavy. I actually had to buy a separate carrying case specifically for it. But honestly, considering the performance, huge screen, cooling system, and overall experience, I think it’s absolutely worth it.This is not a laptop for someone looking for maximum portability. But if you want a true desktop-replacement gaming machine that you can still take with you when needed, the Alienware 18 Area-51 is outstanding. I love it.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Portátil potente y de alta calidad
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: El Lenovo Legion 5 es una excelente opción para los jugadores que buscan un portátil potente y de alta calidad. Con una pantalla Full HD de 15.6 pulgadas y una frecuencia de actualización de 144Hz, la calidad de imagen es impresionante y fluida, lo que hace que la experiencia de juego sea mucho más inmersiva.El procesador Intel Core i7-10750H y la tarjeta gráfica NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 aseguran que el rendimiento del equipo sea rápido y sin problemas, incluso con los juegos más exigentes. Además, cuenta con 16 GB de RAM y un disco duro de 512 GB, lo que ofrece una buena capacidad de almacenamiento y velocidad de acceso a los datos.La construcción del Lenovo Legion 5 es robusta y bien diseñada, lo que lo hace resistente y duradero. También tiene un teclado retroiluminado que es cómodo y fácil de usar durante largas sesiones de juego.En cuanto a las desventajas, el tamaño y peso del portátil puede ser un poco incómodo para transportarlo a menudo. Además, la duración de la batería no es la mejor del mercado, lo que puede ser una desventaja para aquellos que necesiten utilizar el equipo fuera de casa.En general, el Lenovo Legion 5 es una excelente opción para los jugadores que buscan un portátil potente y de alta calidad. Si se busca un equipo que ofrezca una excelente calidad de imagen y un rendimiento sólido, el Lenovo Legion 5 es definitivamente una buena opción a considerar.
Llevo casi 2 años usándola y cumple perfectamente. Trabajo y juego con el portátil todos los días y nunca me ha dado ningún fallo. Contento con la compra

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: This is the best price per perfomance ratio OLED.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I've had this for a bit now so I think I can give it a fair review which I'll update if any burn in occurs at a later time.For the price this screen is an unbeatable value. I got mine for 350 on sell direct from Loch Ness.Performance: Beats any IPS/VA screen I also tried out a mini led before this as well and I can say its much better.The motion clarity is great. The color once adjusted is awesome. The HDR is fine I don't get people who need their HDR to blind them and hurt their eyes, 400 nits is good enough. The main benefit of the HDR is the color saturation anyway, which looks good. Goes up to 180fps which is good enough for competitive, The difference between that and 240hz is 1.5 milliseconds. You would need to be in the top 0.01% in reaction time to even benefit from that in an fps and even then it would be minimal.The screen auto pixel refreshes every 4 hours or so so you need to cut it off and let it do its thing for longevity. The ui for adjusting settings is easy enough to navigate. I saw some of the other review for similar models saying it had a wonky plastic button but this model has a nice silicone set of buttons on the bottom that seem durable.Anyway this screen is perfect for anyone who has a midrange system.One caveat is that you have to turn down the fps for HDR10 to 120 if I remember correctly.Buy this on sale instead of getting a high end IPS screen. It is absolutely worth the investment at the 330-350 price range.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Superb OLED Visuals. Bargain Price.Superb OLED Visuals. Bargain Price.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Every now and then I like to treat myself. I’m not a big spender but I do know what I like. I’ve been an OLED display fan for as long as I remember and my first OLED was a tablet, another Samsung product. To my eye , I’ve yet to see another display type that offers the same levels of color fidelity, black levels and sharpness.I’m not a gamer so things like super-fast refresh rates are somewhat moot to me but I do work on a computer a lot and consume a lot of media in the form of movies and TV. My main display is an LG OLED but in my bedroom system (which also includes 5.1 audio) I was suffering with a 27” LCD TV doubling as a monitor. That was OK for office work and browsing but its gray like black levels were a distraction when watching content with the lights off.The prices of OLED monitors were putting me off but when this model dropped under four hundred bucks I decided to go for it. I’m glad I did. I'm unfortunately not able to go with a larger size in the space I have available, otherwise I would probably have gone for a dual purpose 42" or 48" TV/OLED monitor a while back. This 27' size is, however perfect for my current needs.It is an entry level model. The body is plastic, it has limited inputs: one HDMI and one Display Port. It does have a USB-A socket but that’s for service only; it won’t accept media files for display. The resolution is 1440p. I was a bit concerned at the lack of 4K but that proved not to be a problem. There are no speakers but you can pass-through audio via a 3.5 mm socket for headphones or computer speaker hookup.I didn’t use the included stand, instead choosing to mount the screen on a cantilever arm for ease and flexibility.When I first turned on the TV, connected to my computer over Display Port, the colors seemed overbright (this is common) and the color balance was way off. This was quickly cured by entering the “original” mode and matching the visuals with my LG laptop which this works in tandem with when I’m computing.For AV consumption, I’m feeding the HDMI input with sources from a Roku Express 4K streamer and an Oppo BDP-93 Blu-ray player. At first I thought the visuals were a bit “meh!” but then I realized that my surround receiver, which these devices were routed via, topped out at 1080p resolution. When I connected the monitor directly to the Roku via HDMI, the Roku was fooled into thinking the Samsung was a 4K device and the monitor down-rezzed the signal to 1440p without issue. I have to say, the difference between 1080p upscaled and 4K downscaled was like night and day. Fed with a decent 4K HDR signal, I was hard pressed to tell any difference in quality between what I was seeing on this monitor and the picture on my much larger 4K LG OLED TV in the living room. The picture was superb. Of course that meant I had to ditch my older Marantz receiver and replace it with a more recent version with 4K capability in order to get the best out of the screen. The newer Marantz is also able to upscale my Blu-Ray discs from the OPPO and they look great on this device.Now I couldn’t be happier. I can watch movies and TV in bed in the highest quality imaginable. Everything is super-sharp. Colors are still maybe a little overblown (especially in the blue thru’ teal area) but it’s not a dealbreaker. Skin tones, light reflection, space scenes; everything looks mind blowing.The menu system is quite intuitive once you get used to it and I’m now capable of navigating around quite freely. That said, I have downloaded Samsung Display Manager to my computer to perform the most common tasks like input switching without using the main power/menu input button. I’ve heard this can be quite fragile and break easily and is often refused warranty coverage. Frankly, I’ll do anything to keep this going as long as possible. It’s perfect for my needs. Whether browsing web pages, typing documents, watching YouTube videos or consuming content from other devices, everything looks stunning on this. HDR works great despite a relatively low 200 nits average peak brightness level and black levels and shadow detail in the darkest areas are sublime.This might not be the absolute best choice in OLED monitors (especially for avid gamers) but for most people, I don’t think they’d be missing the kind of specs that can cost hundreds of dollars more. This is a fine product at a very tempting price.

description: Samsung’s 32” M7 Smart Monitor brings AI-powered intelligence to your setup with smart features that adapt to how you work, play, and watch. Smart TV Apps provide instant access to content, and Samsung TV Plus offers additional streaming options. You can launch shows, movies, and more without needing a separate device. The AI Picture Optimizer adapts the visuals for optimal quality whether working, gaming, or watching videos. SmartThings enables control of connected devices, turning the monitor into a central IoT hub via mobile or voice command. Knox Security keeps data safe and confidential, plus it enhances the security of IoT connections made through the Smart Monitor. The 4K UHD display brings content to life in vivid detail with incredible clarity. Active Voice Amplifier adapts to noisy environments and automatically adjusts volume. Click-to-Search offers content details. Gaming Hub enables access to the biggest games from top streaming partners with no PC or console needed.¹Features, services and app availability may vary by country and region. Samsung TV Plus and Universal Guide may not be available in some regions. Some features may require separate subscriptions. The user interface is subject to change without notice. This Smart Monitor does not include a TV tuner, which is not necessary for streaming apps. Internet connection is required. Remote control specifications vary by country and region. Keyboard and mouse control compatibility varies by app. Access to the full range of smart features, such as network-based services, applications (including games and streaming services), and smart home functionality, requires a Samsung Account. Without logging in, functionality is limited to external devices, e.g. via HDMI. You can sign up for a free Samsung Account at https://account.samsung.com. Terms and conditions apply. ²
features: INSTANT ACCESS TO YOUR FAVORITE STREAMING CONTENT: Stream content directly from your monitor, or tune into Samsung TV Plus to get live channels and on-demand content.¹

OPTIMALLY TAILORED VISUALS WITH AI: Experience optimal picture quality adjusted to your needs.² AI Picture Optimizer adapts the visuals to help you work on documents with comfort, get fully immersed in games with deep and rich blacks.

SIMPLE CONTROL FOR YOUR SMART HOME: See your smart home devices in a 3D Map View and manage them with ease.³ You can also check the energy usage and cost by device, and save money by putting them in energy-saving modes.

YOUR PRIVACY. SECURED ON SAMSUNG MONITORS: Keep your monitor data safe and confidential with Samsung Knox.⁴ Its robust, multi-layered security and tightly controlled access also enhance the security of your IoT connections made through your Smart Monitor.

ENJOY YOUR CONTENT IN VIVID DETAIL: Watch your content come to life with incredible clarity.⁵ 4K UHD resolution enhances even fine details in images and videos, making worlds feel more vibrant and realistic.

ADAPTS TO NOISY ENVIRONMENTS: Hear words clearly with AI technology.⁶ Active Voice Amplifier analyzes background noise around the monitor and automatically adjusts the volume of your content, so you can catch dialogue effortlessly - even in loud settings.

DISCOVER WHAT’S ON YOUR SCREEN: Enrich your viewing experience with Click to Search.⁸ With just a click, you’ll instantly get content recommendations and details on what you’re watching - so you can explore actors’ biographies, filmographies and more.

WHERE GAMING COMES TOGETHER: Access the ultimate gaming realm.⁹ In the Samsung Gaming Hub, you can play the biggest games from top streaming partners, with no PC or console needed. Discover new games or replay old favorites all in one place.

CONNECT WITH CONVENIENCE: Connect your gadgets without any adapters. With USB-C, HDMI and USB-A ports, you can charge your device, transmit data, and make the most out of your multi-screen setup - all at once.
