productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Probably good for some users but not as a simple external laptop monitor.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This monitor tries to be everything at once: a computer monitor, a streaming device, a gaming display, and more. If that’s what you’re looking for, you might enjoy it. I just want a simple computer monitor—and that’s where this falls apart.The built-in operating system interferes aggressively with basic monitor behavior. Instead of automatically displaying my laptop when I plug it in, I have to use the remote every single time to tell it to switch inputs. It’s slow, annoying, and completely unnecessary for a product marketed as a monitor.It includes a built-in USB-A hub for a mouse and keyboard, but in my setup the monitor takes control of the mouse and will not pass it through to the computer at all. I had to plug the mouse directly into my laptop to use it. By comparison, I have an LG monitor with multiple inputs and a USB hub that simply stays on the selected input until I tell it otherwise—no fighting the software.To make matters worse, there are no physical controls for brightness, contrast, or color. The picture quality is acceptable, but it’s overly bright and lacks contrast, and I can’t adjust it without using software or downloading an app. I’m not interested in installing an app just to control basic monitor settings that should be accessible on the device itself.Because of the constant friction caused by the smart OS and the lack of basic physical controls, this monitor gets a low rating from me. If you want a “smart TV–monitor hybrid,” this might work. If you want a straightforward computer monitor, look elsewhere.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Superó mis expectativas como monitor para PC
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Estoy complétamente satisfecho con esta compra. La compré por dos razones. La primera es que estaba buscando un monitor grande de 32" como éste. Vengo de usar durante muchos años monitores de 24" full hd, pero mi trabajo me exije estar gran parte del día leyendo en pantalla y escribiendo en procesador de textos, por lo que ya me estaba resultando cada vez más cansado leer en la compu, y prefería la tableta. Mi intención era comprar la versión m5 de este monitor, que es full hd, sin embargo al leer las reviews e informarme sobre los aspectos técnicos, tuve que declinar esa opción porque hubiera sido un retroceso debido a la cantidad de distribución de píxeles en una pantalla grande (al parecer iba a ser más cansado a la vista por la nitidez de las letras). Estaba a punto de optar por un monitor de 27", o uno de 32 qhd cuando di con esta opción. El salto al 4k es enorme. La nitidez de las letras es excelente, y ahora puedo trabajar con varios documentos abiertos a la vez, lo que aumenta a la productividad.Mucha gente se queja por el brillo. En mi opinión es perfecto. Pude configurar el brillo sin problemas, así como el hdr en juegos (aclaro, soy jugador casual, nada de gamer y esas cosas), y la verdad es que los colores se ven vívidos. También puedo cambiar a modo protección de la vista, y otro modo de atenuación automática, según lo que se ve en pantalla, para no cansar la vista, y aunque no lo crean la funcionalidad es muy buena. Cuando pongo películas fullhd o 4k la vívides y contraste de los colores es muy agradable, con negros profundos. Así que en cuestión imagen no tengo ninguna queja (conecto el monitor a través de HDMI).La segunda razón por la cual decidí comprar este monitor es que tiene dos puertos HDMI, uno de los cuales es HDMI EARC. Esta característica por sí sola es muy difícil de encontrar en monitores para PC (sólo es una característica presente en las smart TV). Investigando me di cuenta que ni siquiera los monitores LG equivalentes a este Samsung incluyen el puerto HDMI Arc (sólo dos puertos HDMI 2.1). La razón por la que considero importante esta característica es que la mayoría de los home theaters y barras de sonido traen conectividad HDMI arc (incompatible con HDMI normal), e interfaz toslink. Tengo un home theater Sony HT -S40r y no podía sacar el potencial completo al conectarlo a la computadora. La única forma en la que podía hacerlo era por bluetooth (desaconsejable por que es una calidad muy inferior a conectarlo por cable), y cable toslink (algo poco común en las pcs de hoy en día, y además el ancho de banda que transmite el cable óptico es inferior). Intenté con extractores de audio HDMI, y no tuve suerte. En cambio, con este monitor por fin pude conectar la PC a mi home theater, y con la aplicación Dolby Access he podido sacar el audio como siempre quise hacerlo (con cable toslink sólo es posible sacar audio Dolby comprimido, y no es compatible con el códec de Home Theater de Dolby Access). La sensación que experimento ahora es completamente envolvente, no sólo cuando pongo una película 5.1, sino también un hacer upmix estéreo más que aceptable, algo que a los puristas audiófilos no les gusta, pero quién disfruta de escuchar música de manera inmersiva, como si estuviera en un automóvil es la solución ideal (antes podía hacer upmix estéreo, pero no podía sacar un audio que me convenciera de los parlantes traseros, por lo general era más bajo).El único pero que le pongo al monitor es justamente todas las opciones smart (y por lo que se promociona). Para mí son innecesarias teniendo todo conectado al PC, y todo lo que pide para la instalación (registro, conexión a internet, y demás se me hizo tedioso. Pero por todo lo demás creo que fue un golazo estirar un poco mi presupuesto y adquirir este monitor.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Sharp 4K Display That Works Great for Home and Office Use
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This Gawfolk 27-inch 4K monitor has been a great addition to my desk setup. The 27-inch size feels perfect for both work and everyday use because it gives plenty of screen space without feeling too large or overwhelming on the desk.The 4K UHD resolution is the biggest highlight. Text looks sharp, images look clear, and the extra screen detail makes a real difference when working with documents, browsing, watching videos, or multitasking. Compared to a basic 1080p monitor, the picture quality feels much cleaner and more premium.The IPS panel is also a nice advantage because the colors look consistent from different viewing angles. Whether I am sitting directly in front of it or slightly off to the side, the display still looks good. For normal home office use, streaming, school work, and productivity, it performs very well.I also appreciate that it supports both HDMI and DisplayPort. That makes it easy to connect to different devices like a desktop, laptop, or docking station. The 60Hz refresh rate is perfectly fine for regular work, media, and general computer use.The monitor also has a clean, simple design and does not take much effort to set up. Having wall-mount support is another useful feature if you want a cleaner desk setup or more flexible positioning.Overall, this is a solid 4K monitor with sharp picture quality, good screen size, useful ports, and a clean design. For home and office use, it delivers exactly what I wanted. Five stars!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I was looking to get a 1080p widescreen monitor, as my first one. I needed to upgrade to something with more real estate than my 15.6" laptop screen, and I saw this one, and the cheap cost, and was intrigued. I didn't want a curved monitor, though I can see why someone would want a curved monitor now that I've used this one for a few days. This monitor is *not* curved.It arrived and I plugged it in, fully expecting it to have a dead pixel, or a bad connection, or to be otherwise "bad" in some way, and I was surprised, because it seems fine, so far. Better than I was expecting from a non-name brand monitor with zero reviews online anywhere. No dead pixels, no weird flickering. There was a sticker covering the monitor that tells you to not remove if there is any problems, and to reach out to Gawfolk first, but that protective film has a stamp on it that says the model number of the monitor, and I wasn't sure if that was an issue with the monitor, or if it was with the sticker until I removed it. I'd suggest not having the model number placed on the protective film, or make it more obvious that it's a part of the film and not some fault with the monitor itself.I will say however, the description and information for this model is inconsistent. The manual says to use an hdmi cord that is "HDMI 2 or better" to ensure a good connection, but nothing is listed as to the quality of the cable the monitor ships with. One set of information says it is 1.4, another says 2.1. HDMI 2 is not required because this is not a 8k monitor, and HDMI 1.4 is plenty sufficient for this resolution.The monitor quality seems a little blurry, in a way I can't really explain. Perhaps 34" is too large for 1080p ultrawide? or is it due to the pixel density of the monitor? I'm not entirely sure. It seems to report to Windows 11 that it is 120hz, and best I can tell it does appear to be at 120hz, but I have a hard time discerning hertz over 60. I used to have a 144hz monitor that was side by side with a 60hz monitor and telling the difference side by side "stood out" but it wasn't nearly as obvious as going from 480p to 1080p, for example would be. My laptop has 165hz but it all seems rather meaningless to me.I'm also docking it a point because there is *zero* height adjustment, and the attachment to the back is a bit flimsy. I haven't tried to see if it is VESA mount capable because I don't have the mount arm anymore I used to have. If you want the monitor to be higher up, you will need to put it on a box, or use a VESA mount. You *can* tilt the monitor, but that seems a bit meaningless to me because the tilt is not much.I primarily use this for gaming, and it seems to be fine for gaming, besides the issues I had mentioned.I took a risk and so far everything turned out okay. I'll update my review in the future if anything changes.

It's great for both gaming and multitasking.The picture quality is excellent. Colors look vibrant and accurate, and everything on the screen looks sharp. When I first set it up, the brightness was set to 50%, but adjusting it was simple through the monitor's built-in settings menu.The control buttons are located on the bottom of the monitor. At first, it was a little frustrating because you can't easily see them, but once you learn where they are, they're easy to find by touch and navigate without any issues.One thing I personally don't love is that the cables connect from the bottom rather than the back of the monitor. That's mostly a matter of preference, though. I can see how the bottom-facing ports could actually help create a cleaner-looking cable setup for many users.The stand was also easy to assemble. After screwing the stand together, it simply snaps into the monitor, making setup quick and straightforward.The only potential drawback I noticed is that the monitor uses a unique mounting system for its stand. If you're planning to use a different stand or a monitor arm, you may want to check compatibility first, as it doesn't appear to connect the same way many other monitors do.Overall, I'm very happy with this monitor. It offers excellent color quality, plenty of screen space, and an easy setup process, making it a great choice for gaming, work, or everyday use.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I needed a compact computer for my home office because my old desktop was taking up way too much space on my desk. After using this mini PC for a few weeks, I’m honestly impressed with how much performance is packed into such a small unit. Getting everything set up was quick, and I was working within minutes. I mainly use it for email, spreadsheets, video meetings, online research, and managing files, and it handles everything smoothly. Programs open fast, multitasking feels effortless, and the system stays responsive even when I have several things running at once. One feature I didn’t expect to enjoy as much as I do is the customizable lighting. It adds a nice touch to my workspace without being distracting. The compact size also freed up valuable desk space and made my setup look much cleaner. Storage has been more than enough for my documents, photos, and everyday files. Overall, this has been a great addition to my office. It delivers reliable performance in a surprisingly small package and has easily met all of my daily computing needs. I’m very pleased with how well it has fit into my work routine and would definitely purchase another one if needed.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: After the initial disappoint of faulty supplied HDMI and Windows 11 Home edition not the PRO as advertised, both issues were resolved to my satisfaction by the sellerBought the unit for its great price at time of purchaseThe points that stood out for me were thePRO edition of Windows 1116 GB of DDR5 RAM512 GB SSDUHD GraphicsI was quite impressed with the boot time (about 5 seconds and you're ready to go!)Overall speed is quite fast, don't understand why some complain at the N95 clock speedsThe quoted base frequency is 1.7 GHz (boost is up to 3.4 GHz), just put the unit in power mode for higher speeds, with only 15W power consumption you can easily run this unit at higher speeds and always powered on if you want16 GB DDR5 RAM size and speed is beneficial for the graphics chip (the integrated ones normally grab a lot of RAM! also, as for web browsers that have multiple tabs open)The UHD graphics look great on my 4K+ monitor (don't use the other 2 HDMI outputs)The USB 3-A ports can easily support hub/adaptor for use with other types of port if required (e.g. USB-C)I use the Wi-Fi to connect to the internet, other computers, and printers, although the LANs may be useful in some cases) Wi-Fi is also fast (its connected to an extender at the moment)The installed SSD is fast and large enough for most purposeOverall, this is a pretty fast little machine that I delighted with; I can't comment on gaming as I last did this when Space Invaders was out (this unit has cost a lot less than graphic cards I have installed on my PCs)Ideal for general computing purposes and it takes up minimum spaceAt least I won't have the cost of any upgrading which I have tended to do with other PCsPurchased an extended 3-year warranty for only £18 (hope I don't need it)AddendumSo much for not going to upgrade (been messing around basically)I replaced the original M2. sata drive with a M2. NVMe 512GB PCIe gen3X4 (the original is now my backup)Can only use 2 lanes in the M2 slot so don't get the full speed, about >3X read increase and 2.5 writeIt does make a noticeable difference when loading apps and large filesThe memory speed can be set to 4800 MHz which is higher than the original setting, this is max for an N95Check other media sources for fine tuning etcAs a side note I manged to install Chrome OS on a USB 256GB SSD drive (much faster than USB flash drives and more suitable for purpose), voila.. can now use it as a Chrome computer much like my old LG Chromebase.. but a lot faster!, so just boot with the USB when I want this option, great!

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I bought this item on 04/10/2024, and I have been very impressed with its performance for such a small device. It's fantastic for basic work such as using Microsoft Office, web browsing, and so forth. My wife uses this PC to teach English online through Skype and the cloud app provided by her company.  I was surprised at how many peripherals you can connect to this little box! You can run it connected to three screens via the three separate HDMI sockets provided and I love the fact that this system has two network cards. So could go down a couple of routes such as assigning 1 NIC to WOL or you can connect both NICs and load balance.  I did hit a problem with this PC with the PC shutting down after being switched on. I reached out to the manufacturer via email and provided my Amazon Invoice as proof of purchase. They were very quick to reply and the issue was resolved. It turned out that the HDMI to VGA adaptor I was using was somehow knocking out the display and causing the PC to freeze.  Testing the little PC by connecting it to my huge HDMI TV and leaving it running for up to five hours proved it was the HDMI to VGA adaptor. Long story short don't use old equipment!So question 1 Would I buy this PC again - Answer Yes definitelyQuestion 2 What do I think about Technical Support? I think if I were not technically IT literate I think most customers would have hit a problem, although I noted that underneath the PC is a list of companies in different countries that you could contact.  Having said that the Tech support provided by email was high quality in the options and suggestions to resolve the problem.One niggling issue that probably only applies to me, I noted that if you placed this PC on a flat wooden or slate surface I could hear the vibration of the fan underneath. I have very good hearing so I found it a bit annoying. If you pick the PC up IT IS DEAD QUIET which to me is amazing. I know that a base plate is provided so that you can attach this PC to the back of a monitor or TV but I think a little accessory like a small stand with holes for airflow would work well. It could also help with noise dampening on certain surfaces. Might get a friend to 3D print one for me
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on March 5, 2025

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Still early days, but a week after purchasing we are very impressed with the speed and quality of this amazing little machine.'ve always built my own desktop computers for my day job as a designer which involved choosing a processor, mother board, hard drive, ram, cooling system and tower case etc. But we wanted something to replace an old thinkpad laptop which we were using with a usb hard drive as a media server in the living room for the family home entertainment system.I had not realised how compromised our previous setup was until I unleashed this new mini pc - The speed and responsiveness of everything you do pretty much matches the much more elaborate (and expensive) desktop tower I use for work. Surfing the internet, listening to our music or watching our movies is now in proper 4K with no lags or glitches.I'm seriously considering getting another one of these beasties to replace my work PC. So small, neat, quiet and unobtrusive - it just gets on doing what you need without complaint!
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on June 9, 2026

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Nice mini-pc, can't comment on the OS...
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Seems like a pretty good mini PC.  Others seem to have had issues with Windows, drivers, etc.  but since Windows is an appalling mess of an OS that I never use unless I am compelled to, I was never going to run it on this box, so I've not had those issues.  As soon as I got it, I installed a decent OS (i.e. Linux), and it's just been sitting there and running for the last couple of weeks.  I bought it to use as a Zabbix monitoring server and Wireshark network sniffer.  Right now with Zabbix monitoring about 30 devices, it's barely breaking %CPU of 5%, with 5 minute load average of around 0.5.  I'll likely put some more infrastructure components on it at some point, so we'll see how that goes, but right now it seems pretty solid.On the physical side, build quality seems fine, the selection of ports is good enough for my purposes, and whilst others have mentioned hearing the fan, I've never heard it kick in - that might be because I'm not stressing the CPU, though, I suppose.In conclusion, I'd happily buy another if I had the need for it.

This APU supports up to 32 GB of dual-channel DDR4-2400 memory and incorporates Radeon Vega 8 Graphics operating at up to 1.2 GHz. 20% Multi-core Performance increase over previous Ryzen 3 models such as 4300U. 35% performance increase over the Intel N-series N95/N97/N150.

Better graphics: With Vega 8, it's superior for casual gaming, video playback, and GPU-intensive tasks. Overall higher performance: Higher boost clock and better ability to handle a variety of workloads, from light gaming to productivity tasks. So, if you're looking for a more balanced processor with stronger multitasking capabilities and better GPU performance, the Ryzen 5 3500U would be the clear choice.

16GB DUAL CHANNEL DDR4 + 512GB SSD - Installed with DDR4 16GB SO-DIMM RAM Dual Channel (2x8GB) and a 512GB SSD, the Nucbox G10 mini pc supports memory expansion to 64GB RAM. Featured with Dual M.2 2280 PCIe 3.0 slots, supports dual storage slot expansion to 16TB SSD (2*8TB). (Upgrades not included) This model supports a configurable TDP-down of 12 W and TDP-up of 35 W.

UNLEASH RAW PERFORMANCE MODE 25W - Dominate demanding tasks with the AMD Ryzen 5 3500U processor. productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Best Cost to performace ratio ive seen so farBest Cost to performace ratio ive seen so far
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Been using this for my Arch setup, and everything is easy to tweak and install.The quality of the edges are better than most I see on other nucboxes, and I use it with no  problems with latency with my display playing Starcraft on max quality.  I've also been using it as a NAS, and its been working. The windows 11 comes preinstalled, so it was very little at time consuming for any of the initial setups. The size was enough to punch it inside my room corners, and takes very little power from the previous models that uses n100.The compatibility is top notch, as it's easy to install a new ssd or ram by popping up the title cover, and add away to your heart's desires. I added an extra 1TB to dual boot, but it's definitely managable with just 512 gb of storage. The fans are pretty much silent. never knew they were even running until I was halfway on my cyberpunk with max resolution. The front two usb 3.0 ports are fast for booting and reading, while the bios is fast and secure boot disabled, which saved me from having to troubleshoot why my grub wasn't loading for 2 hours.  Would recommend for a general purpose PC to run steam, use as a distro tester, or just have one to add to your NAS.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Fast, low wattage, and powerfulFast, low wattage, and powerful
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Really happy with my purchase, the M8 is a little workhorse. I can confirm it comes with an activated Win 11 Pro. Even though GMK has never seen an issue, I have a ritual - I boot from USB and image the NVME fresh (after getting the Windows key from a command line just in case), then wipe the mini pc's NVME (deleting all partitions) and install Windows 11 fresh. Windows picked up the BIOS key automatically on install and launched right into a fresh Windows 11 Pro. Network and sounds drivers were missing, but I grabbed them from the Europe site (Google it) and ran the .bat file. Without a reboot, everything picked up and no yellow exclamation marks in Device Manager. Windows Update took about 20 mins, as I fresh installed the newest Win 11 version (25H2 as of this writing).So the PC itself is rock solid, no blue screens, streams OBS 4k just fine, and have no random crashes or reboots. It's a great Docker server or workstation PC if needed, runs Office just fine. I notice no loud fan noise. Can’t comment on Oculink, I don’t use it.If you're looking for an all-in-one on the Ryzen platform, this one is a good bang for the buck.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I would have given it 5 stars, if it had not became inoperable within a week.  The problem was most likely due to a Windows update that removed necessary hardware definition files.  With the help of GMKtec people, I was able to get it working again using their link to download a rescue utility. I created a bootable USB (ISO) on another computer.  I re-booted the GMKtec with the Microsoft USB ISO starting with the least intrusive tool, then continuing on to the next level recovery tool within Microsoft "advanced utilities", until the problem was solved.  I lost no files or programs or settings.  This is a great little computer.  I purchased this unit to run a once-a-year program that requires Windows 11.  I added a second NVMe drive then installed the operating system that I trust for daily, efficient, flawless, and spy-free operation... Debian 13.  Installing a drive on this computer is so easy...just pop off the top and insert it.  This computer is as strong and functional as a Intel i5 series 8.  For those who prefer an uncluttered desk, install this powerful, little box to the back of the monitor.  Processing speed, graphics and storage are more than enough, even for power users.  I am very happy with my purchase and I would buy it again.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: It's a good PC.  Windows 11 does not do it any justice. It will work for gaming. But not for large games in ultra quality if you're gaming on this you're going to be in 1080P at low or ultra low quality with all of the cool stuff turned off that makes your game look nice. If you want a game in low quality there you go.. this is the perfect device for you. I mainly got it for photo editing and video editing and creative type of work because it's small and it will attach directly to the back of your monitor. However if you put it into performance mode it runs uncomfortably Hot for me. 90° + c is a little too hot for my comfort and then the nvme starts throttling.. so if you wanted to work keep it in balanced mode it will still game in that mode. Just have your driver settings correctly.. other than that it's really snappy it looks great it does what it's supposed to do.. I don't have any complaints. And I'm coming straight off of a gaming laptop from 10 years ago and it's about on the level with that.. it can't run the games as well because it doesn't have a proper GPU but it's close..

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Very capable mini PC, Good for any office workVery capable mini PC, Good for any office work
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I bought the GMKtec G10 mainly as an everyday office and home machine, and after a few weeks of daily use I'm impressed by how much computer you get for this price. With 16GB RAM and 512GB SSD, it's at a very good price in this RAMpocalypse.This combination of hardware makes a real difference in day-to-day responsiveness. Windows boots in seconds (keep in mind that it comes with Win 11 Pro, not home, so extra features are unlocked), apps launch instantly, and there's none of the lag you'd expect from a machine this small and affordable. For the kind of work most people actually do: email, Word, Excel, big spreadsheets, PDFs, a browser with a dozen-plus tabs open, plus Teams or Zoom running in the background, it just handles it.The thing that genuinely surprised me is the multitasking headroom. I regularly have multiple HD video streams going at once. A YouTube video in one window, a webinar in another, and a video file playing on a second monitor, all while I'm typing in a document and flipping through browser tabs. The integrated graphics plays the video smoothly, no stutter, no fans screaming. Even the integrated speakers are, while not great, very usable.Connectivity is excellent for the size. I was very surprised to see 2.5GbE LAN port in a machine this small. The triple 4K display support via HDMI, DisplayPort, and USB-C let me run a multi-monitor setup without any docks or adapters. Plenty of USB ports up front and back, so peripherals were a non-issue.A few honest notes: this is a 15W mobile-class chip, so it's built for productivity and media rather than serious gaming or heavy video rendering. If you go in expecting an office and daily-driver machine, you'll be delighted; if you expect a gaming rig, that's the wrong tool. It runs cool and quiet under normal load, which I appreciate on a desk.Bottom line: for the price, this is one of the best value office mini PCs I've used. As a fan of mini PC's, this is not my first time buying from GMKTEC and they did not disappoint. Easy recommendation for a home office, small business, or anyone who wants a tidy, capable everyday desktop that fits under or behind their monitor.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Bought this a year ago. I have been happy with this for my media server during that time.First thing I did was backup and remove Windows (backup in case I had to return this item).It came with a 1T nvme drive.  I added a 2T SSD (the literature does not always show that this can be done) and a 2.5g network adapter (USB).I installed Ubuntu server on a small 128G external SSD.  On that drive I also installed Plex, Plexamp headless server, and CamillaDSP.  The Beelink is hooked to a Topping DAC with USB.  All media is on the 1T and 2T drives.It serves video to the connected TVs in the house, music to network connected speakers, and music to the main stereo through the DAC.  It never stutters or buffers.  The fan can be loud, but I rarely hear it run on high.  When not in use it is put to sleep with an SSH command from my phone.  Wake-up is from a WOL app.My model has a 5800H cpu with 16G and 1T storage included.  Price and performance is much better now after 13 months. No surprise there.

aPlusContent.rawText:
Product description
The video showcases the product in use.The video guides you through product setup.The video compares multiple products.The video shows the product being unpacked.
Dell 16 Plus 2-in-1 AI Laptop
A stunning 16-inch screen built for versatile use with on-device Copilot+ featuring the latest Intel Core Ultra processors, designed to deliver the ultimate power efficiency and performance for the newest AI experiences in a sleek and stylish 2-in-1 laptop. 
Technical Specifications 
Processor 	Intel Core Ultra 7 256V Processor (up to 4.8 GHz, 12MB cache, 8 cores, 8 threads, 47 TOPS NPU) 	
Display 	16" WUXGA (1920 x 1200) LED, 300nits, 60Hz, ComfortView Plus, touchscreen display 	
Graphics 	Integrated Intel ARC Graphics 	
Memory 	16GB LPDDR5X 8533MT/s RAM 	
Networking 	Intel Wi-Fi 7 BE201, 2x2, 802.11be + Bluetooth 5.3 	
Operating System 	Windows 11 Home 64-bit 	
Battery 	4-Cell, 64WHr, 65W Type-C AC power adapter 	
Webcam 	1080P FHD camera, Dual-array microphones 	
Audio 	Stereo speakers with Realtek ALC3329 Audio Controller, 2.5W x 2 = 5W total peak 	
Keyboard 	English Backlit Copilot Key Keyboard, Numeric Keypad 	
Security 	TPM, Fingerprint reader 	
Dimensions 	14.05" x 9.87" x 0.67" 	
Weight 	4.52lbs 	
A stunning display, in any mode 

Create and edit on a versatile 16-inch screen with space for all your tool bars. Get into the natural flow of writing or drawing in tablet mode, or see more on the 16:10 screen as you tackle complex data sheets or work seamlessly across multiple windows side by side. Catch smaller details on dashboards and graphs or just enjoy watching your favorite content on this stunning 16-inch screen in tent mode. 
Effortlessly tackle the newest AI experiences 

Built from the ground up with Intel’s latest and most advanced client compute engines designed to deliver the newest AI experiences, ultimate power efficiency, and full day cooler and quieter performance that creators and workers need, wherever they are. 
Intel Core Ultra processors feature dedicated engines for specific tasks, resulting in exceptional performance, efficiency and battery life. 

Impressive processing power 
Dedicated engines for demanding tasks deliver exceptional performance, efficiency, & battery life. 
Up to 21 hours 
Work confidently wherever with impressive battery life that lasts during marathon sessions. 
Experience AI in versatile ways 

Unlock your full potential with new AI experiences like creating custom visuals for projects, presentations or even social media posts. Editing or enhancing photos, videos even music, save time analyzing large amounts of data, let AI detect trends and create charts and dashboards for easy visualization within minutes - seamlessly and efficiently without draining your battery. 
Recall 

Using simple prompts and natural language, Recall instantly scans apps, files, emails and websites you’ve seen before to retrieve exactly the content you’re looking for. 
Live Captions 

With Live Captions, you stay connected and never miss a conversation. Instantly translate your video calls or movies from any app or video platform into English subtitles, in real time. 
Cocreator 

Help bring your creative aspirations to life with custom images through Cocreator. Enabled with advanced AI, you can now transform rough sketches with text and drawing prompts and make your vision come to life, just the way you want it. 
Windows Studio Effects 

No need for extra lights or soundproof rooms—new Windows Studio effects help you look and sound your best. Voice Focus filters out background noise and makes sure you are heard. This AI-enabled feature improves lighting and blurs distractions, so you’re always the focus. 
Secure and reliable 

Crafted with high quality materials and designed for durability, all Dell Plus laptops undergo rigorous military-grade testing to ensure exceptional reliability as you put it through the rigors of everyday use. And an additional layer of security with the built-in Trusted Platform Module to protect your data. 
Versatility meets creativity 

Seamlessly switch between laptop, tablet, tent, and stand modes, enjoying unparalleled versatility for work, play, and everything in between. 
Built-in FHD+ webcam for crystal clear video calls. 
Enjoy clear, distraction-free calls and recordings with AI noise cancellation for enhanced communication. 
Stylish modern design with rounded edges that is easy to carry around.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Good performance and build quality for a budget mini-PCGood performance and build quality for a budget mini-PC
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: This mini-PC comes in a clean package and the N95 processor balances power efficiency with speed. The processor is great for general desktop use, and can be used as a server for non-graphic-intensive (e.g. running surveillance software such as BlueIris, Omada Client, etc.), but limited ability makes it non-ideal as a Plex server or for moderate gaming.WALK-AROUNDThis computer has a matte finish with grey vents which has a premium look to it. The top of the computer is all-grate and labels, and this is the intake for the active fan. The right and left sides are only grates. The front panel incudes a power button, 3.5” audio jack, USB-C, two USB-A ports, and a recessed clear CMOS button. On the rear panel is the primary exhaust, LAN port, two USB-A ports, two HDMI ports, and a DC power in. The bottom of the unit is solid black; some labels, and anti-slip tape at the corners. The miniPC measures roughly 5” x 4.5” x 1.75”; the included power cord is 57” long.PERFORMANCEThis PC handles day-to-day tasks with no trouble. From off, time to login screen is around 18 seconds; after logging in, the desktop virtually immediately after pressing enter. While stressed, the fan will run but it isn’t overly noisy, especially if the miniPC can be located under a desk or attached the back of a monitor.PERFORMANCE – BENCHMARKINGI used 3dMark CPU Profile to benchmark this against my aging i7-6700k server. The Bosgame performed better at up to 4 threads, while the old i7 did better with 8+ threads. Below are benchmarks of the Bosgame (my i7-6700k performance in parenthesis for comparison):- 1 thread – 390 (122)- 2 threads – 724 (250)- 4 threads – 1210 (922)- 8 threads – 1212 (2725)- 16 threads – 1207 (2817)- Max threads – 1207 (2733)SECURITY & BLOATWAREAfter setting up the computer, but before connecting it to my network, I installed MalwareBytes and did a full scan. No findings, and I haven’t come across any bloatware so far.MISCELLANEOUSAfter Windows 11 configures and installs, I’m left with 436GB (of 474GB) space on the SSD. The Windows installation and updates went flawlessly.THE GOOD+ Great performance for desktop usage+ Extremely low power consumption+ Good overall valueTHE BAD- Requires special power plug (with external power supply); not USB-COVERALLThis is a solid low-power mini-PC option, but for most applications, I’d prefer the flexibility of a higher-powered CPU (such as a Ryzen7 5800U).

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Set up was easy and straightforward.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: For a basic laptop in the budget range, it appears to work fairly well. Set-up was easy (a bit time-consuming with Windows updates but that's how things go). The fit and feel of the laptop is good. This is a replacement for a crashed 3 year old HP Pavilion that had the motherboard die on it. As others have mentioned, having a backlit keyboard would be nice, but I knew what I was getting. Speed is good and getting my settings changed to how I like them went smoothly. I use a wireless mouse, so can't comment on the touchpad very much as I never liked them. My only issue is the warantee ... the seller registered the device about 11 months ago, so I will not get the full manufacturer's warantee as stated in the listing. Hopefully, it won't be necessary but I was a little gun shy after the previous HP fried the motherboard after only 3 years (although with a lot of travel involved). I had to spring for the 2 year warrantee through Amazon just in case.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on July 6, 2024

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: A really great Laptop!A really great Laptop!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I am really pleased with this laptop! I run photo editing software so my system has to have lots of RAM. This is terrific! The plentiful hard drive storage is an added bonus, I had to use an external HD on my previous laptop. The processor is a little old but it's still nice. Other laptops with similar specs were priced at least $100+ higher. My photo editing software runs pretty well on this and surprisingly the machine doesn't get hot. I highly recommend this for anyone looking for a really nice laptop that's actually affordable. I'm not a gamer so I can't speak to that but this thing is exactly what I was hoping it would be! I have absolutely no complaints. The seller also shipped this quickly and safely. It arrived in pristine condition. I truly couldn't be happier with my new laptop!
